/** * DecisionCard * Naming DecisionCard. what the agent made, and the ways forward. * Variant none. * Token bg brand-tint (a tinted ground), radius sm, padding 12/16. icon brand-ink. buttons: tint (review) + primary (proceed). * Structure Icon + Title (wraps) + two Buttons. below 640 the buttons drop to a second row so the title keeps its words. * no neutral gray fills on this tinted ground. * Usage Rule use where the next step branches. the person has to press to move on; the agent never auto-advances here. */ import * as React from "react" import { FileText } from "lucide-react" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" interface DecisionCardProps extends React.HTMLAttributes { title: string reviewLabel?: string proceedLabel: string onReview?: () => void onProceed?: () => void } function DecisionCard({ title, reviewLabel = "검토하기", proceedLabel, onReview, onProceed, className, ...props }: DecisionCardProps) { return (
{title}
) } export { DecisionCard }
